convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iWPR indicator with simple crossover entry/exit rules and fixed lot sizing. No external dependencies or custom indicators.

other_exits: Signal reversal: opposite WPR signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative lot value treated as fixed lots, positive treated as risk fraction of free margin

custom_logic_notes: EA uses CExpert and CExpertSignal standard library classes. WPR values from previous completed bar (shift=1) are used for signal generation. The signal logic: WPR crossing above -80 (oversold) triggers buy; WPR crossing below -20 (overbought) triggers sell. Position closing is handled by the signal reversal mechanism within CExpert - when an opposite signal is generated, the existing position is closed before a new one is opened. SL/TP/Trailing values use digit adjustment (multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use ta-lib or pandas-ta WPR indicator (period=14). Entry: WPR[1] crosses above -80 for long, WPR[1] crosses below -20 for short. Must implement new-bar guard to prevent multiple entries per bar. SL/TP in pips with 5-digit broker adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit). Trailing stop is fixed-pip based. Position sizing: negative Lots param = fixed lots, positive = fraction of free margin. Use CExpert pattern: close opposite position on reversal signal.
